description: nuuEnergy - Das sind WIR! Unsere Mission: Wir bringen die Wärmewende in die Zukunft und bauen ein System für lokale Handwerks-Betriebe, das Qualität und Effizienz vereint. Das ist nicht einfach und viele sind hier schon gescheitert – bei Qualität, bei Kultur, bei Prozessen. Aber wenn wir diese Challenge meistern, gestalten wir die Zukunft einer ganzen Branche. Konkret heißt das: Wir entwickeln das Betriebssystem für unsere Wärmepumpen-Standorte deutschlandweit — von Prozessen, über Kundenakquise und Handwerker-Hiring bis hin zu unserer eigenen Software. Wir sind ein Startup im Aufbau: Vieles entsteht gerade erst, und genau dafür brauchen wir dich. Wir haben top Investoren im Rücken, ein starkes Gründer- & Führungsteam und die Motivation das Handwerk auf ein neues Level zu bringen. Deine Aufgaben Als Senior Venture Architect baust du die Strukturen und Systeme, mit denen nuuEnergy skaliert, und steuerst die Unternehmensentwicklung. Aktuell heißt das vor allem: Du bringst unsere Standortleiter zum Laufen. Das heißt du führst sie nicht nur, sondern baust die Systeme, mit denen sie eigenständig performen. Darüber hinaus bist du der unternehmerische Arm der Gründer: Du übernimmst, wo es noch keinen klaren Owner gibt, triffst Entscheidungen im Auftrag der Geschäftsführung und arbeitest cross-funktional mit allen anderen Leads. Kein Verwalter-Job, sondern ein Gestalter-Job. Deine Aufgaben Standortmodell zum Laufen bringen: ein wiederholbares Modell bauen, mit dem Hubs eigenständig, wirtschaftlich und menschlich stark laufen. Standortleiter zu echten Unternehmern vor Ort entwickeln: technisch starke Menschen bei Führung und Organisation coachen, Konflikte in Handwerksteams lösen und Standards durchsetzen, ohne die Teams zu entmündigen. Wichtige Sonderprojekte schnell von 0 auf 1 bringen und neue Geschäftsmodelle mit Venture Builder Methoden testen & entwickeln. Team- und Orga-Probleme eigenständig lösen (Ziel: der Großteil läuft ohne die Gründer). Personalentscheidungen mittragen — inkl. Trennungen, wenn nötig. A-Player-Quote im Team messbar machen und aktiv steuern. Cross-funktional mit allen Leads relevante Business-Entscheidungen vorbereiten und im Auftrag der Geschäftsführung treffen. Die Geschäftsführung in Meetings, gegenüber Team Leads und extern vertreten. Dein Profil Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und wohnhaft in München Echte Startup-Erfahrung: Im Aufbau (z.B. Venture Building, Early Stage, Wachstums-Phase) – kein Corporate-Hintergrund. Führungserfahrung: Menschen geführt, aufgebaut und auch harte Personalentscheidungen getroffen. Builder Mindset: Du bist Generalist/in und baust lieber Systeme, als sie zu verwalten. KPI-fokussiert: Du steuerst mit Zahlen, nicht mit Bauchgefühl. Persönlichkeit: Hungrig, hohe Arbeitsbereitschaft, Lust auf Aufbauen unter Unsicherheit. Mobilität: Reisebereitschaft zu unseren Standorten. Branchenerfahrung: Wärmepumpen, Energie, Handwerk, Bau oder dezentrale Servicemodelle (Logistik, Retail, Franchise etc.). Was dich bei uns erwartet Eine der einflussreichsten Rollen im Unternehmen, direkt an der Geschäftsführung – mit klarer Wachstumsperspektive für jemanden, der liefert. Fixgehalt plus Bonus plus relevante Unternehmensbeteiligung (VSOP) – du baust mit auf und partizipierst am Erfolg. Maximaler Gestaltungsspielraum in einem schnell wachsenden Markt. Klingt nach dir? description: Deine Mission Alle reden über AI. Wir entscheiden, wie sie im Unternehmen wirklich eingesetzt wird. Ein 400-Milliarden-Dollar-Markt. Und mittendrin ein Team, das nicht primär Code schreibt, sondern entscheidet, was AI im Unternehmen bewirken soll - für mehr als 25.000 Talents in über 70 Ländern, durch Automatisierung und intelligente Prozesse. Wir suchen dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce) in unserem Headquarter in München -Schwabing für unsere cross-funktionale strategische Taskforce. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Strategy, Business und AI - als Sparringspartner:in für AI Engineers, Product- und Operations-Expert:innen sowie eine ehemalige BCG-Beraterin. Nicht als zusätzliche:r Engineer im Team, sondern als die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das Team das Richtige baut. Das ist keine klassische Werkstudentenstelle für Techies. Du strukturierst Probleme, baust Business Cases, bewertest AI-Anwendungen aus Business-Perspektive und übersetzt zwischen dem, was technisch möglich ist, und dem, was strategisch sinnvoll ist. Die Konzepte, an denen du arbeitest, landen nicht in einer Schublade - sie fließen direkt in Entscheidungen unseres Leadership-Teams ein. Was du wirklich machst AI-Strategie statt AI-Code: Du arbeitest an strategischen AI-Initiativen wie unserem Talent Assistant oder AutoQA 2.0 (KI-basierte Voice-File-Analyse) mit - nicht als Entwickler:in, sondern als jemand, der Anforderungen strukturiert, Prioritäten setzt und aus ersten Ideen belastbare Feature-Konzepte macht. Die technische Umsetzung übernehmen unsere AI Engineers; du sorgst dafür, dass sie das Richtige bauen. Aus Ideen werden Entscheidungen: Du analysierst komplexe Fragestellungen, baust Business Cases nach klassischer Case-Logik auf und entwickelst Entscheidungsgrundlagen für unser Leadership-Team. Deine Analysen beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche AI-Initiativen umgesetzt werden. AI braucht Struktur: Große Sprachmodelle sind nur so gut wie die Daten dahinter. Du definierst Kompetenzframeworks und Bewertungslogiken, die unsere AI-Systeme intelligenter machen - die inhaltliche Logik, nicht die technische Implementierung. Eigene Projekte mit echtem Ownership: Du übernimmst eigenständig Themen von der ersten Analyse bis zum ersten Konzept - ein neuer AI-Use-Case, ein Workflow, der heute noch manuell läuft, eine Automatisierung, ein neuer Lösungsansatz. Der Inhalt wechselt, der Anspruch nicht: Du bekommst Verantwortung, nicht nur Aufgaben. Dort arbeiten, wo gerade der größte Hebel liegt: Du unterstützt unser Team dort, wo aktuell die spannendsten strategischen Fragestellungen entstehen. Das bedeutet Abwechslung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und sichtbaren Impact. Warum diese Rolle dich außergewöhnlich schnell wachsen lässt Hier lernst du nicht programmieren - du lernst, wie man AI-Investitionen bewertet, Business Cases baut, die vor Geschäftsführung und Leadership bestehen, und komplexe Themen so strukturiert, dass daraus messbarer Business Impact entsteht. Genau das Handwerk, das du später in der Strategieberatung oder im Corporate Strategy-Umfeld brauchst - nur, dass die Empfehlung hier real umgesetzt wird und nicht in einer Präsentation endet. Du arbeitest eng mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin sowie AI Engineers und Product-Expert:innen zusammen und bewegst dich täglich zwischen Strategie, Business Judgement und AI. Die letzte Werkstudentin ist anschließend als Trainee bei uns eingestiegen - nicht, weil wir es versprechen, sondern weil sie während ihrer Zeit bei uns bereits Verantwortung übernommen hat. Dein Skillset Akademischer Hintergrund: Du studierst aktuell im Master (BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar) und bringst bereits erste praktische Erfahrung mit - idealerweise mit strategischem oder analytischem Fokus. AI-affin, kein AI Engineer: Du musst nicht coden können und keine Modelle bauen. Aber du nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT als Power-User für Recherche, Analyse und Strukturierung - und verstehst, wie AI Geschäftsprozesse verändert. Wichtiger als technisches Tiefenwissen: Du erkennst, welches Problem ein AI-Use-Case eigentlich lösen soll. Fähigkeiten: Du strukturierst komplexe Sachverhalte sauber und nutzt PowerPoint und Excel sicher genug, um überzeugende Management-Präsentationen und Business Cases aufzubereiten. Mindset: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand den nächsten Schritt erklärt. Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein, denkst unternehmerisch und willst Lösungen entwickeln statt Aufgaben abzuarbeiten. Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst und präsentierst in verhandlungssicherem Deutsch und Englisch und verfügst natürlich über eine gesunde Portion Humor. Rahmenbedingungen: Du hast 16–20 Stunden pro Woche während des Semesters Kapazität, bei uns vor Ort im Münchner Headquarter tätig zu sein. In der vorlesungsfreien Zeit flexibel bis Vollzeit möglich. Dein Winning Deal Deine Chance: Vom ersten Tag an arbeitest du an einer der strategisch wichtigsten AI-Initiativen unseres Unternehmens mit und gestaltest Lösungen, die den Arbeitsalltag tausender Menschen verbessern können. Dein Buddy: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin, die dich individuell begleitet und fordert. Dein Netzwerk: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit AI Engineers, Product-, Strategy- und Operations-Expert:innen - Einblicke, die klassische Werkstudentenstellen selten bieten. Deine Perspektive: Ein anschließender Einstieg als Trainee ist ausdrücklich möglich und in unserem Team bereits mehrfach Realität geworden. Deine Benefits: Neben weekly Pizza und Snacks vor Ort, bieten wir dir außerdem einen Joblunch-Zuschuss (4 x 6,90 € im Monat), eine bezuschusste Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits" sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents. Dein Arbeitsplatz: Flexibles, hybrides Arbeitsmodell in einem unserer modernen, hundefreundlichen Büros. Dein Beitrag: Eine Position in einem profitablen Unternehmen, in dem du die Freiheit und das Vertrauen hast, mitzugestalten und mit uns an der „Future of Work" zu arbeiten. Unsere Werte: Eine offene, authentische Kultur und ein leistungsstarkes, humorvolles Team, das sich darauf freut, gemeinsam mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen. raw.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & AI Innovation
raw.description:
Deine Mission

Alle reden über AI. Bei uns baust du mit.

Ein 400-Milliarden-Dollar-Markt. Ein profitables Scale-up, das ihn mit AI und einem globalen Freelancer-Netzwerk neu denkt. Und mittendrin ein Team mit einer klaren Mission: die Qualität für mehr als 25.000 Talents in über 70 Ländern durch AI, Automatisierung und intelligente Prozesse kontinuierlich besser zu machen.

Wir suchen dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & AI Innovation in unserem Headquarter in München-Schwabing für unsere cross-funktionale strategische Taskforce. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Strategy, AI und Operations - gemeinsam mit AI Engineers, Product- und Operations-Expert:innen sowie einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin.
 
Das ist keine klassische Werkstudentenstelle. Du analysierst Probleme, entwickelst Lösungen, testest AI-Anwendungen und hilfst dabei, Ideen in echte Produkte zu verwandeln. Die Konzepte, an denen du arbeitest, landen nicht in einer Schublade - sie werden prototypisiert, diskutiert und fließen direkt in Entscheidungen unseres Leadership-Teams ein.
 
Was du wirklich machst

  • AI-Produkte mitentwickeln statt nur darüber sprechen: Du arbeitest an strategischen AI-Initiativen wie unserem Talent Assistant oder AutoQA 2.0 (KI-basierte Voice File Analyse) mit und hilfst, aus ersten Ideen konkrete Features und funktionierende Prototypen zu entwickeln - unter anderem mit Claude, ChatGPT oder Lovable.
  • Aus Ideen werden Entscheidungen: Du analysierst komplexe Fragestellungen, bereitest Business Cases auf und entwickelst Entscheidungsgrundlagen für unser Leadership-Team. Deine Analysen beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche AI-Initiativen umgesetzt werden.
  • AI braucht Struktur: Große Sprachmodelle sind nur so gut wie die Daten dahinter. Du unterstützt beim Aufbau von Kompetenzframeworks, Bewertungslogiken und Trainingsdaten, die unsere AI-Systeme intelligenter machen - nicht als Datentipper, sondern als jemand, der mitentscheidet, was überhaupt bewertet werden soll.
  • Eigene Projekte mit echtem Ownership: Du übernimmst eigenständig Themen von der ersten Analyse bis zum ersten Prototyp - ein neuer AI-Use-Case, ein Workflow, der heute noch manuell läuft, eine Automatisierung, ein neuer Lösungsansatz. Der Inhalt wechselt, der Anspruch nicht: Du bekommst Verantwortung, nicht nur Aufgaben.
  • Dort arbeiten, wo gerade der größte Hebel liegt: Du unterstützt unser Team dort, wo aktuell die spannendsten strategischen Fragestellungen entstehen. Das bedeutet Abwechslung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und sichtbaren Impact.
Warum diese Rolle dich außergewöhnlich schnell wachsen lässt
Wenn dich AI wirklich interessiert, lernst du hier nicht nur neue Tools kennen, sondern wie daraus Produkte entstehen: wie aus einer Idee ein funktionierender Prototyp wird, wie man AI sinnvoll in Geschäftsprozesse integriert, wie man eine Empfehlung entwickelt, die vor Geschäftsführung und Leadership Bestand hat - und wie man komplexe Probleme so strukturiert, dass daraus messbarer Business Impact entsteht.
Du arbeitest eng mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin sowie AI Engineers und Product-Expert:innen zusammen und bewegst dich täglich zwischen Strategie, Produktentwicklung und AI. 
Die letzte Werkstudentin ist anschließend als Trainee bei uns eingestiegen - nicht, weil wir es versprechen, sondern weil sie während ihrer Zeit bei uns bereits Verantwortung übernommen hat.


Dein Skillset

  • Akademischer Hintergrund: Du studierst aktuell im Master (BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar) und bringst bereits erste praktische Erfahrung mit.
  • AI begeistert dich wirklich: Du musst keine Software entwickeln können - aber du beschäftigst dich freiwillig mit AI. Vielleicht nutzt du Claude oder ChatGPT täglich, hast schon mit Lovable oder Cursor experimentiert oder fragst dich regelmäßig: "Das müsste man doch automatisieren können." Genau diese Neugier suchen wir.
  • Fähigkeiten: Du strukturierst komplexe Sachverhalte sauber und nutzt PowerPoint und Excel sicher genug, um überzeugende Management-Präsentationen und Business Cases aufzubereiten.
  • Mindset: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand den nächsten Schritt erklärt. Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein, denkst unternehmerisch und willst Lösungen entwickeln statt Aufgaben abzuarbeiten.

title: Product Manager E-Invoicing (m/w/d)
description: Warum Wir? Bei uns erwarten Dich weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams, flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur, die zum Mitgestalten einlädt. Mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören für uns zum Alltag. Möchtest Du Teil eines innovativen Unternehmens werden, dessen Lösung den Arbeitsalltag in unterschiedlichsten Branchen digitalisiert? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams! Das erwartet Dich Als Product Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die Anbindung von DocuWare an Netzwerke zum Austausch von e-Invoices in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, UX- und Compliance-Spezialisten. Gemeinsam stellt Ihr sicher, dass DocuWare die Anforderungen unserer Kunden an den Austausch von elektronischen Rechnungen erfüllt. Dabei behältst Du die regulatorischen Anforderungen und Zeitpläne im Blick und hilfst unseren Kunden, diese mit DocuWare zu erfüllen. Du kannst dich in die Lage unserer Anwenderinnen und Anwender versetzen und ihre Probleme und täglichen Aufgaben nachvollziehen? Du bist neugierig, arbeitest gerne lösungsorientiert und im Team, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und bist ein Organisationstalent? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennen zu lernen! Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören: Du verfolgst die Entwicklungen und Anforderungen für e-Invoicing in und außerhalb Europa in Zusammenarbeit mit externen und internen Compliance-Spezialisten. Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Anforderungen und Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden. Du agierst dabei kundenzentriert, holst Kundenfeedback ein und analysierst Daten, um die richtigen Entscheidungen abzuleiten. Du formulierst präzise Anforderung zu den Kundenproblemen und -bedürfnissen. Du entwirfst die kurz-, mittel- und langfristige Strategie und Roadmap für Deinen Bereich unseres Produkts und führst das Team mit Zielen und KPIs. Du prägst eine konstruktive und integrative Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Produktteams und agierst als Teamschnittstelle zu Stakeholdern. Du arbeitest eng mit Softwareentwicklern und UX-Spezialisten an der Implementierung des Produktes im Rahmen des SCRUM-Frameworks zusammen. Das bringst Du mit Du verfügst über breites und tiefes Wissen im Bereich e-Invoicing. Die Begriffe XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, FatturaPA und Factur-X sind für Dich keine Unbekannten. Du kannst die Unterschiede zwischen PEPPOL, SDI, Chorus Pro und FACe in wenigen Worten verständlich erklären. Du hast Erfahrung als Produktmanager für Software-Produkte. Erfahrung mit B2B Software ist ein Plus. Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem agilen Umfeld (beispielsweise als SCRUM Product Owner). Du hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Endnutzern und der Lösungsgestaltung anhand deren Bedürfnissen. Du verfügst über ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten, arbeitest zielorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung. Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich darzulegen. Eine Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Teamfähigkeit zeichnen Dich aus. Fließende Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Es gibt viele gute Gründe für DocuWare – unsere Unternehmenskultur ist nur einer davon. Im Team von DocuWare profitierst auch Du von diesen Vorteilen: Weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams: Du triffst uns in Germering, New York, Sofia oder vielen anderen Locations. Flexibler Arbeitsort und Arbeitszeit: Du arbeitest mobil oder in unserem modernen und gut ausgestattetem Büro – dabei teilst Du Dir deine Arbeitszeit flexibel ein. Individuelle Förderung: Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung bekommst Du regelmäßig auf Dich zugeschnittene Weiterbildungen (u.a. Kongresse, interne Teambuilding Maßnahmen). Wohl verdiente Erholung: Neben 35 Urlaubstagen im Jahr bieten wir Dir ein breites Sport- und Massageangebot, Kicker-Tisch und einen entspannenden Lounge-Bereich. Gesunde Ernährung: Zusammen genießen wir Fairtrade Kaffee mit Bio-Milch oder HaferDrink, Snacks und frisches Obst – alles kostenlos – sowie bezuschussten Lunch aus dem Foodji-Kühlschrank. Team-Spirit: Regelmäßige Events für Mitarbeitende - virtuell oder vor Ort sorgen für Zusammenhalt. Nachhaltigkeit und soziales Engagement: DocuWare steht für papierloses Arbeiten und unterstützt ehrenamtliche Organisationen und lokale Sportvereine. Gute Erreichbarkeit auf allen Wegen: Komm ins Büro mit dem geleasten E-Bike (Jobrad), per S-Bahn oder über die Autobahnen A96/A99 (Dein E-Auto kannst Du vor Ort kostenlos laden). Du sorgst vor & wir unterstützen Dich dabei: DocuWare bezuschusst Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Ein stabiler Arbeitsplatz: In unserem langjährig bestehenden und stetig wachsenden Unternehmen erhältst Du eine unbefristete Festanstellung. Wir nutzen immer die neuesten Technologien: Erfahre mehr auf Stackshare. Einzigartige Vorteile: Wähle eine von drei großartigen Optionen (Bonago, E-Gym oder Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets) nach Deinen Bedürfnissen. 30 Tage Work from Abroad: Erlebe internationale Erfahrungen und erweitere Deinen Horizont. Family First: Bevorzugte Anmeldung in unserer ausgewählten Kindertagesstätte in Germering (keine Garantie). Buddy Programm: Du erhältst einen Buddy, der Dir den Einstieg erleichtert und Dich in Deinen ersten Wochen bei DocuWare unterstützt. Für noch mehr Einblicke, schau doch gerne auf unserem Instagram vorbei! Kontaktperson Chiara Drechsel Team Lead Recruiting & Employer Branding Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Bei unserem namhaften Kunden im Raum Aalen - einem führenden Unternehmen der Hightechindustrie - bietet sich diese einmalige Perspektive im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung mit der Option auf Übernahme.

Dein zukünftiger Tätigkeitsbereich

  • Die Product-Vision einer anspruchsvollen Software für die Produktion von optischen High-Tech Systemen zusammen mit dem Scrum-Team weiterentwickeln

  • Die Entwicklung eines oder mehrerer Softwareprodukte im Umfeld komplexer Produktionsprozesse verantworten

  • Die Anforderungsaufnahme bei Produktion- und Entwicklungsabteilungen leiten und in einem Product Backlog in einzelne Entwicklungsaufgeben herunterbrechen, dokumentieren und priorisieren

  • Als Ansprechpartner für die Klärung von fachlichen Rückfragen agieren - Aufwände zusammen mit dem Team abschätzen und bei der Planung von Sprints unterstützen

  • Eine Schnittstelle für die agile und klassische Projektwelt für die Stakeholder schaffen, um sowohl kurzfristige Sprintplanung als auch langfristige Meilensteinplanung zu ermöglichen

  • Die Einführung von Softwareprodukten in der Produktion durchführen und als Ansprechpartner bei Problemen fungieren

  • Die Abstimmung mit den anderen Scrum Teams zur weiteren Standardisierung von Architekturen durchführen und als Servant Leader ein selbstorganisiertes Team unterstützen

Das zeichnet Dich aus 

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium Informatik (m/w/d), alternativ ein naturwissenschaftliches oder ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium oder vergleichbar

  • Erfahrung in der Leitung von Softwareprojekten, der Analyse von Anforderungen und fundierte Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung

  • Erfahrung in der Mitarbeit in agilen Teams sowie Erfahrung in der Rolle als Product Owner

  • Ein hohes Prozessverständnis und die Fähigkeit komplexe Probleme einfach zu abstrahieren (z.B. mittels Diagramme)

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (B2)

  • For international applicants: Please note that the business language is German. B2 level is mandatory and must have for this position

Deine berufliche Zukunft

  • Vergütung: Übertarifliche Bezahlung zuzüglich Branchenzuschläge

  • Work-Life-Balance: Uns ist die Vereinbarkeit von Job und Familie sehr wichtig, daher sind 30 Tage Urlaub und ein Gleitzeitkonto selbstverständlich

  • Karriere bei Top Unternehmen: Freue dich auf langfristige Einsätze bei renommierten Unternehmen der Region mit echter Übernahmeoption!

  • Mitarbeiter-Benefits: Profitiere von betrieblichen Zusatzleistungen wie Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld, bezuschusste betriebliche Altersvorsorge und VWL

  • Wachsendes Unternehmen: Mit starkem Auftragseingang und Dynamik

  • Firmenveranstaltungen: Freu Dich auf das traditionelle jährliche encontec-Standortfest

  • Persönliche Betreuung: Dein persönlicher Ansprechpartner steht Dir jederzeit zur Seite und kümmert sich um all Deine Anliegen

title: Bank Relationship and Analytics Manager (m/f/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the&nbsp;<strong>FinTech</strong> connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers <strong>better interest rates</strong> and banks a <strong>diversified form of refinancing</strong>. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.</p> <p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from&nbsp;<strong>more than one million investors</strong> which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.</p></div><p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>Team<br></strong></span>Join the Deposits department, the group responsible for making some of Raisin’s most important strategic relationships grow and succeed. In a key dual role you will support both teams in the department.</p> <p>The Bank Analytics team drives Raisin’s business with analytics, research, and insights to platforms and wider funding markets. You’ll provide tailor-made funding guidance to our partner banks by leveraging internal and external data. The team’s analyses and guidance drive strategic decision-making both in- and outside the company.</p> <p>As a Relationship Manager, you’ll work directly with senior stakeholders at banks, helping them succeed on our platform and shaping long-term collaboration.</p> <p>In addition, you will contribute to key projects - from launching new savings products on the marketplace to supporting technical bank migrations and much more. Because our impact and stakeholder network are broad, we maintain a unique view of priorities and upcoming changes, which colleagues across the business rely on.</p> <p><br><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive market and funding intelligence: Analyze European and US deposit and funding markets, as well as customer behavior on our platforms to deliver clear, visual insights into key trends and uncover opportunities.</li> <li>Provide strategic funding advice: Help partner banks navigate their funding goals by providing market indications, deposit forecasts, and actionable growth strategies.</li> <li>Understand and enable: Develop a solid understanding of each bank’s requirements and help align them with Raisin’s platform, working closely with our marketing, distribution, and partner teams to help unlock growth.</li> <li>Own and grow partnerships: Build strong, day-to-day relationships with our partner banks, ensuring smooth collaboration and shared success - enabled by in-person meetings.</li> <li>Drive impact across projects: Contribute to special initiatives — from launching new savings products to supporting strategic rollouts — and play an active role in shaping how we deliver value.</li> <li>Collaborate globally: Work with colleagues across different markets and teams on key projects, bringing guidance, structure and clarity to complex challenges.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Profile</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience (including relevant internships) in consulting, banking, or financial services, with a strong desire to learn how to manage professional stakeholders</li> <li>Excellent English communication skills, with the confidence to communicate clearly and professionally across teams; German nice-to-have</li> <li>Strong academic background in business, finance, economics, or a similar field.</li> <li>High attention to detail and excellent organization skills</li> <li>Structured problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>A growth mindset, proactive attitude, and a strong willingness to be hands-on and dive into the details.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!</strong></p> <p>At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.</p> <p>As part of our team, you will benefit from</p> <ul> <li>Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.</li> <li>Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.</li> <li>A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.</li> <li>Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.&nbsp;</li> <li>Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.</li> <li>Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.</li> <li>Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.</li> <li>You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><a href="https://www.raisin.com/corporate/raisin-applicant-privacy-policy/"><em>Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy</em></a></p> <p data-start="728" data-end="900">We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.</p> <p data-start="907" data-end="1013">We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.</p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

KI-Architektur & Stack-Entscheidungen setzen (30%): Du definierst die unternehmensweiten Prinzipien, triffst grundlegende Stack-Entscheidungen und etablierst Patterns, die andere Teams wiederverwenden. Tech-Ansatz bewerten & weiterentwickeln (15%): Du prüfst unseren aktuellen Ansatz kritisch und entscheidest mit Begründung, ob er bestätigt, geschärft oder abgelöst wird – inklusive Migrationspfad. Zentrale KI-Plattform designen (25%): Du baust die Integrations- und Gateway-Architektur sowie eine providerneutrale Modell-Policy, auf die das gesamte Unternehmen aufsetzt. B. Claude Code oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen Verhandlungssicheres Englisch (mindestens B2) Freude daran, Standards in einer gewachsenen, dezentralen Organisation über Überzeugung statt Weisung durchzusetzen Idealerweise hast du außerdem ein tiefes Verständnis von Retrieval-Architekturen, Agenten-Orchestrierung und evaluationsgetriebener Entwicklung und Erfahrung darin, sowohl Engineering-Teams als auch Geschäftsführung von Architekturentscheidungen zu überzeugen Deine Vorteile Jährliches, großzügiges Fortbildungsbudget und Katalog für interne Trainings, externe Seminare, Konferenzen und Keynotes Viel Raum für Kreativität, Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung Unbegrenzter Zugang zu unserer Hightech-Werkstatt “MakerSpace” Die flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und die Homeoffice-Möglichkeit ermöglichen eine gute Work-Life-Balance Zugang zu TU-Krippenplätzen, Teilzeit- und Elternzeitmodelle, Kinderbetreuungszuschuss Flexibles, monatliches Mobilitätsbudget über die Moovster App (MVG, Lime, Uber, Jobrad, etc.) Umfangreiches Sportprogramm (Yoga, Pilates, Achtsamkeit, Cross Fit, Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, sowie Zugang zu TUM-Sportangebote) Vielfalt ist uns wichtig Vielfalt bereichert unser Team. There's plenty to tackle, and we're excited to find the right people to take on the challenge.

 

What we’re looking for

Essential

  • 3+ years experience with PHP

  • Strong, business oriented, engineer with modern PHP development experience (PHP 8.0+ is a must)

  • High degree of ownership and autonomy

  • A good understanding of Symfony

  • Experience with Domain Driven Design, Message-Driven Systems and Event Sourcing would be a plus

  • Strong automatic testing skills (unit, integration, functional, behat)

Desirable

  • Experience working on financial systems

  • A keen desire to want to learn and input into a highly collaborative team

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We're building a larger, dedicated Platform team at Lendable, increasing our investment in the infrastructure that enables our products and engineering teams to scale.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to sit within Engineering and connect platform technology, reliability and commercial value. You'll own what we prioritise and why, giving engineers the business context they need while helping Product and leadership understand the impact and opportunities that Platform enables.

This is a hands-on technical IC role, where you'll stay close to engineering through writing code, reviewing PRs and contributing to architecture discussions.

Working closely with the Platform Engineering Manager and Tech Lead, you'll help shape the Platform roadmap, connect technical investment to measurable business outcomes, and build the foundations that allow Lendable to move faster and scale with confidence.

What you'll be doing

Own platform stability

  • Own platform stability as a primary accountability - SLA/SLO metrics, incident rates, release quality.

  • Hold release gating authority: block features from production that don't meet testing standards or introduce unacceptable regression risk.

  • Enforce CI/CD standards centrally so pods don't fragment into one-off solutions.

  • Track and report stability metrics alongside commercial outcomes - stability is the foundation that makes the rest possible.

Be commercially accountable

  • Own the business case for platform investment and answer "why are we spending six engineers on this for three months?" in terms leadership understands.

  • Track platform impact in business terms: developer velocity, incident cost, time-to-market, reliability, capacity - e.g. "CXO rollout removes a 3-second API fan-out, reducing session abandonment" or "we can now handle 20k simultaneous logins".

  • Input into headcount and investment decisions for the platform team.

Own the platform roadmap

  • Own the platform backlog, prioritised by business value and sequenced to unblock the highest-value product teams first - not driven by technical debt or engineer preference alone.

  • Make trade-offs explicit: "if we do X now, we defer Y by Z weeks - here's what that means for products depending on us".

  • Ensure every initiative has a defined success metric that non-engineers can track.

Be the stakeholder interface

  • Act as the single point of contact for Pod Leads: business requirements coming from pods and engineering/developer requirements flowing to pods; prioritise both in service of platform stability.

  • Make platform work visible to leadership - regular forums with product MDs and PMs to capture upcoming dependencies before they become blockers; represent platform work in leadership reviews; translate technical milestones into business milestones.

  • Drive cross-team collaboration and buy-in with other PMs; engage architecture in technical design.

  • Escalate when product teams make requests that would create unsustainable platform load or technical debt.

Contribute as an engineer

  • Write code, review PR's, and participate in architecture design as a core part of the role - not a side project.

  • Bring a strong technical voice to roadmap decisions without owning final architecture calls (that's Architecture and Tech Leads).

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Deep, hands-on engineering background - this role must be staffed by someone who has shipped production systems, not someone who has only managed backlogs.

  • Strong commercial instinct: can build a business case, speak to P&L impact, and hold a line on ROI.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management across product, engineering, and finance without direct line authority over all of them.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity - platform value is often indirect and long-horizon.

  • Track record of contributing as an IC while operating at a senior, cross-team level.

  • Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator - able to hold a line with leadership and pod leads alike.

Nice to have

  • Experience in platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling contexts.

  • Familiarity with SLA/SLO frameworks and incident management at scale.

  • Experience enforcing CI/CD standards across multiple teams or pods.

  • Prior work making "invisible" infrastructure legible to non-technical leadership.

Our tech stack

Platform & backend: Kotlin, AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Gateway & clients: Node GraphQL gateway, React Native / TypeScript mobile app, Relay.

Tooling & observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

Interview process

  • Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)

  • Technical and Product interview (90 minutes)

  • Culture-add interview (60 minutes)

Life at Lendable

title: Security Engineer - UK - Remote
description: Job Description At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. We're looking for a Security & Trust Specialist to join Pencil at a pivotal moment of growth. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time. Key responsibilities: Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand. Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools. Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration). Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself. Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating. Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling. Your background: A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work. Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration. Comfortable with cloud basics (GCP, AWS or Azure IAM) — you don't need deep cloud engineering experience, but you're curious and capable of learning fast. Some exposure to compliance or audit evidence gathering (Vanta or similar) is a bonus, not required. A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet. A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop. You’ll Thrive Here If You… You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human). You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners). You take ownership of problems end-to-end and don't wait to be told what to do (Owners). You can explain technical issues simply to non-technical colleagues (Simple). KPIs & Success Measures Access reviews and joiner/mover/leaver tasks completed within SLA, with zero access-control audit findings. Endpoint compliance rate (encryption, patching, MDM enrolment) across the device fleet. Time-to-close on security incidents and IT/device issues you support. Quality and completeness of evidence you contribute to Vanta and vendor reviews. Benefits: 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme Health insurance / private medical cover Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development Remote - work from anywhere in your home country Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees Flexible working hours Deep Dive About Pencil Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI. We’re called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past. Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500. https://www.trypencil.com About The Brandtech Group The Brandtech Group’s mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology. It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022. Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco Itaú, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever. In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of Pokémon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content,, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund). The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time.

Key responsibilities:

  • Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand.

  • Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools.

  • Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration).

  • Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself.

  • Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating.

  • Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling.

Your background:

  • A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work.

  • Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration.

  • Comfortable with cloud basics (GCP, AWS or Azure IAM) — you don't need deep cloud engineering experience, but you're curious and capable of learning fast.

  • Some exposure to compliance or audit evidence gathering (Vanta or similar) is a bonus, not required.

  • A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet.

  • A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human).

  • You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners).

  • You take ownership of problems end-to-end and don't wait to be told what to do (Owners).

  • You can explain technical issues simply to non-technical colleagues (Simple).

 

KPIs & Success Measures

  • Access reviews and joiner/mover/leaver tasks completed within SLA, with zero access-control audit findings.

  • Endpoint compliance rate (encryption, patching, MDM enrolment) across the device fleet.

  • Time-to-close on security incidents and IT/device issues you support.

  • Quality and completeness of evidence you contribute to Vanta and vendor reviews.

 

Benefits:

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees

  • Flexible working hours

Deep Dive About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We’re called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group’s mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco Itaú, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of Pokémon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content,, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund).

The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. It was named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies 2021 by Fast Company, and by CB Insights as one of the World's Most Valuable Private Unicorns.

https://www.thebrandtechgroup.com

title: Senior Consulting Engineer
description: <p>MongoDB Professional Services (PS) works with customers of all shapes and sizes, in all verticals, from tier-1 banks to small web startups, on a variety of exciting use cases. This role solves technically sophisticated problems, gains incredible cross-stack experience, works with top-notch people in the business, networks with industry leaders, and sees new places – all in a day’s work!</p> <p>MongoDB PS exists to support the development of our customers’ vision, accelerate customers’ time to value, and drive a multitude of customer adoption scenarios – from building new solutions to modernizing legacy applications or migrating to cloud. Our consulting solutions ensure that organizations get the best out of MongoDB.</p> <p>This role will be based remotely in Great Britain</p> <h3>We’re looking for someone with:</h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of software development/consulting/support experience, preferably in a number of distinct industries/verticals</li> <li>Competence in at least one of the following languages (in no particular order): Java, C#, Python, Node.js (JavaScript), Ruby, Go</li> <li>Experience with databases such as MongoDB, Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL</li> <li>Familiarity with Linux diagnostics and tuning; Windows tuning knowledge is a plus</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations</li> <li>Excellent analytical, diagnostic skills, and problem-solving skills</li> <li>High motivation for a role that combines deep technical and customer-management dimensions</li> <li>Confidence speaking and presenting in a collaborative customer setting</li> <li>Should be capable and comfortable with frequent travel for short trips to customer sites during the working week (up to 15%)</li> <li>Experience working with Public Sector customers</li> </ul> <h3>What you will do in this role:</h3> <ul> <li>Contribute to customer implementations at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: portfolio assessment, application planning and design, deployment architectures, development and build, integration and release configuration, system testing, production operations, application optimization, and best practices adoption</li> <li>Deliver customer classroom-based training to architect, developer, and operations roles</li> <li>Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising fellow consulting engineers, project managers, and account teams</li> <li>Cultivate your individual MongoDB reputation as a trusted advisor to guide MongoDB and our customers into the future</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap</li> </ul> <h3>As a Senior Consulting Engineer, you will be successful in this role when you can execute the following:</h3> <ul> <li>Become a field expert in “everything MongoDB”</li> <li>Communicate complex technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences</li> <li>Gain a reputation as a trusted advisor with your clients, large and small</li> <li>Ensure your client’s success with their MongoDB endeavors</li> <li>Maintain the required level of billable utilization</li> <li>Influence MongoDB product development by contributing experience from the field</li> <li>Successfully communicate the product roadmap to external clients</li> <li>Constantly work on improving yourself, our products, and our team</li> </ul> <h3>About MongoDB</h3> <p>MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.</p> <p>With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.</p> <p>Our compass at MongoDB is our <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company">Leadership Commitment,</a> guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.&nbsp;</p> <p>To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb">From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy</a>, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys.<a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture"> Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB</a>, and help us make an impact on the world!</p> <p>MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</p> <p>MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.</p> <p><em>Req ID: 3273514642</em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Designer - Core UX
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/newsweek-top-100-global-most-loved-workplaces-2023">Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&amp;badge=0&amp;autopause=0&amp;player_id=0&amp;app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We're looking for a <strong>Product Designer</strong> to help shape the shared experiences and systems that connect Hudl's products.</p> <p>Hudl is bringing together products used across sports, teams and organizations into a more connected platform. That creates design problems that don't always fit neatly within a single feature or product: how information is structured, how common workflows behave across products, how video and data work together, and how emerging technologies like AI change the way people interact with Hudl.</p> <p>You'll work within Core UX, the team responsible for the design foundations that help Hudl's products feel clear, consistent and connected. Our work includes shared patterns and experiences, information architecture, video and data, and the systems that help product teams build at scale.</p> <p>In this role, you'll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Solve connected problems.</strong> You'll work on experiences that cross features, products and workflows, considering how individual design decisions fit into the broader Hudl platform.</li> <li><strong>Make complexity easier to understand.</strong> You'll turn complicated workflows, information and technical constraints into experiences that feel clear and intuitive.</li> <li><strong>Work across teams.</strong> You'll partner with product, engineering and other designers to understand problems, explore solutions and help create experiences that can work at scale.</li> <li><strong>Design from evidence.</strong> You'll learn directly from customers, use research and product data to inform your work, and test and iterate on ideas as you go.</li> <li><strong>Own your work through delivery.</strong> You'll independently run scoped design projects, working from early exploration through implementation and measuring how well the solution works once it's shipped.</li> </ul> <p><strong>For this role, we're currently considering candidates who are within commuting distance of our offices in London, but we're also open to remote candidates in the U.K.</strong></p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strong product design craft.</strong> You can turn complex requirements into clear, intuitive experiences through strong interaction and visual design. You know how to choose the right methods and level of fidelity for the problem, moving between exploration, prototyping and delivery.</li> <li><strong>Systems thinking.</strong> You're comfortable working through ambiguity, naturally look for connections, and consider how a solution might affect other workflows, users or parts of a product.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative communication.</strong> You can explain your thinking, seek out feedback and work through different perspectives with product, engineering and design partners.</li> <li><strong>Customer and evidence focus.</strong> You're comfortable talking with customers and using research, product data and other evidence to make and evaluate design decisions.</li> <li><strong>AI fluency.</strong> You actively use AI tools in your design process and are curious about how AI changes the products we design. You're comfortable experimenting with emerging interaction patterns and thinking critically about where AI can improve an experience.</li> <li><strong>A strong portfolio.</strong> You can show how you've worked through product problems, including your reasoning, collaboration and iteration rather than only the final solution.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience with complex or connected products.</strong> You’ve designed experiences that span multiple workflows, surfaces or parts of a larger product, and understand how individual design decisions contribute to a cohesive experience.</li> <li><strong>Experience with data-rich or technical products.</strong> You’ve designed products involving complex data, analytics, video or other technically challenging workflows.</li> <li><strong>Experience with design systems or information architecture.</strong> You’ve worked with shared patterns, design systems, information architecture or other foundations that help experiences scale across a product.</li> <li><strong>AI product design experience.</strong> You’ve designed conversational, agentic or other AI-powered experiences and have explored emerging interaction patterns beyond traditional interfaces.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role</h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Champion work-life harmony</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Guarantee autonomy</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Encourage career growth</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Provide an environment to help you succeed</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Support your mental and physical health</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We care about our employees’ wellbeing. Our Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups and fitness partner Peerfit have you covered.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Cover your medical</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span><strong>insurance</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We have multiple plans to pick from to ensure you’ll have the coverage you (and your dependents) want, including vision, dental, fertility healthcare and family forming benefits.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Contribute to your 401(K)</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. Yep, that’s free money. We’ll match up to 4% of your own contribution.</span></li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The base salary range for this role is displayed below—<strong>starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.</strong></p> <p>We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£51,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£86,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Inclusion at Hudl&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.&nbsp;<br><br>We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, <a href="https://www.hudl.com/about-inclusion" target="_blank">including employee resource groups and communities</a>. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in <a href="https://www.hudl.com/about-inclusion" target="_blank">annual inclusion reports</a>.&nbsp;<br><br><span style="font-weight: 400;">We also know imposter syndrome is real and the <a href="https://www.theatlantic.com/magazine/archive/2014/05/the-confidence-gap/359815/" target="_blank">confidence gap</a> can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.</span></p> <h2><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></h2> <p><strong><a href="https://www.hudl.com/jobs/hudl-applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hudl Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy</span></a><br><br></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 2 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

What we’re looking for 🌱

We firmly believe that data is core to our mission to build the place where small businesses can get the funding they need to win. It is our key asset and is fundamental to the growth of our company. As such, we’re looking to strengthen our Data Product team to help us continue to build a world class data ecosystem, working on cutting edge data concepts and technologies.

This role will work closely with a team of data engineers & analytics engineers to build data products, supporting key stakeholders across the business - including risk, data scientists, commercial …and more!

What you'll be doing

  • Be a senior member of the data product team, reporting into the Lead Data Product manager, responsible for enabling Funding Circle to be data driven and to help grow our data maturity.

  • Support and coach junior colleagues in data product management.

  • Support Senior Data leaders with strategic development of Data Products at Funding Circle.

  • Be a data champion, enabling the transformation of the way data is thought of and implemented at Funding Circle.

  • Build a strong network of stakeholders within the business, understanding their objectives, translating them into a prioritised roadmap of work.

  • Become an SME and take ownership of the OKRs and planning cycles of your domain.

  • Work with engineers to help shape solutions that deliver value to our stakeholders - from making new data available to creating useful, structured datasets for analytics.

  • Act as a translator between product engineering teams producing data and reporting and analytics teams using data to align roadmaps and requirements.

  • Work with the wider teams to maximise the value realised from our data using cutting edge data technologies.

Skills we’d love to see:

  • Proven experience of understanding stakeholder goals and turning them into successful products.

  • Experience managing a wide group of stakeholders across all parts of the business, joining the dots to create solutions that work for everyone and prioritise work within the engineering team.

  • Experience of working with data platforms (data warehouse / data lake) and understanding the core elements that make up these platforms.

  • Experience of working with Data Scientists, Analysts and / or BI teams

  • Proficiency in SQL for data exploration and analysis.

  • Be the voice of the product, translating technical delivery into business outcomes and communicate this out eﬀectively.

  • You like to get into the details and solving problems but can also step back and communicate the bigger picture.

  • You build collaborative and constructive relationships.

  • Understand what's possible with data and the impact it has on an organisation.

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

As Director of Engineering, you are responsible for building the organisation that makes Hawk-Eye's Performance & Insight products easy to build, scale, maintain. Your mission is to build a lean organisation with AI at the heart of it, capable of scaling through technology. Your organisation addresses the needs of top-tier sport clients - clubs, leagues, federations - seeking access to data and insights to unlock the next level of performance. You will lead and manage a ~50 people strong organisation, including web/mobile/data/cloud engineering. You will aim to scale the organisation and productivity with AI delegation patterns wherever possible. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership and Management Build and lead a high-calibre Product & Engineering function with strong technical credibility and operational judgement. Hire, develop, and align engineering leaders and specialists across sports and disciplines within P&I Foster a culture of accountability, clarity, calm execution, and continuous improvement. Act as a senior internal leader who can bring structure to complexity without becoming bureaucratic. Live by and advocate Hawk-Eye’s values: Be Owners, Be Brave, Be Inclusive. Engineering Standards and Shared Ways of Working Create practical standards to enable strong reliability, platform quality, operational readiness, and shared data governance across the whole of Hawk-Eye’s engineering. Balance central consistency with enough flexibility for different product and domain needs. Partner with product and engineering leaders so shared platform and data standards improve delivery speed. Operational Leadership Identify systemic reliability risks, fragile dependencies, and operational bottlenecks early, and drive resolution. Introduce visible service health, ownership, and numeric baselines for the critical systems under your remit. Use major tournaments, flagship customers, and real operating pressure as proving grounds for improved resilience and trust. Transition the P&I organisation to structured and disciplined operational management. Enabling AI-Ready Foundations Build the platform, data, and governance conditions required for AI-enabled software delivery to scale safely. Ensure shared services, modular interfaces, and governed data access create the right foundations for future AI acceleration. Provide leadership for internal engineering enablement through the Developer Experience function. Define, build, and own Hawk-Eye’s internal Platform-as-a-Service. About You You want to make a difference in the world of sports, and HawkEye is your vehicle to do it. You are a strong technology leader with real experience building data-driven product capabilities in organisations where reliability, scale, and coordination matter. You join HawkEye with the know-how in creating the ownership, standards, operating discipline, and trust that make good engineering practices useful in practice. You are credible with senior engineers, comfortable in operationally demanding environments, and able to move between cloud infrastructure, data foundations, organisational design, and delivery reality without losing the plot. You know how to centralise what must become shared capability without hollowing out the autonomy and judgement of teams that build on top of it. You care about engineering quality, but you care just as much about business consequence. You know that reliability protects customer trust, governed data creates leverage, and shared standards only matter when they make the organisation materially better at delivering outcomes. As Director of Engineering, you are responsible for building the organisation that makes Hawk-Eye's Performance & Insight products easy to build, scale, maintain.

Your mission is to build a lean organisation with AI at the heart of it, capable of scaling through technology. Your organisation addresses the needs of top-tier sport clients - clubs, leagues, federations - seeking access to data and insights to unlock the next level of performance.

You will lead and manage a ~50 people strong organisation, including web/mobile/data/cloud engineering. You will aim to scale the organisation and productivity with AI delegation patterns wherever possible.


Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Management

  • Build and lead a high-calibre Product & Engineering function with strong technical credibility and operational judgement.

  • Hire, develop, and align engineering leaders and specialists across sports and disciplines within P&I

  • Foster a culture of accountability, clarity, calm execution, and continuous improvement.

  • Act as a senior internal leader who can bring structure to complexity without becoming bureaucratic.

  • Live by and advocate Hawk-Eye’s values: Be Owners, Be Brave, Be Inclusive.

Engineering Standards and Shared Ways of Working

  • Create practical standards to enable strong reliability, platform quality, operational readiness, and shared data governance across the whole of Hawk-Eye’s engineering.

  • Balance central consistency with enough flexibility for different product and domain needs.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders so shared platform and data standards improve delivery speed.

Operational Leadership

  • Identify systemic reliability risks, fragile dependencies, and operational bottlenecks early, and drive resolution.

  • Introduce visible service health, ownership, and numeric baselines for the critical systems under your remit.

  • Use major tournaments, flagship customers, and real operating pressure as proving grounds for improved resilience and trust.

  • Transition the P&I organisation to structured and disciplined operational management.

Enabling AI-Ready Foundations

  • Build the platform, data, and governance conditions required for AI-enabled software delivery to scale safely.

  • Ensure shared services, modular interfaces, and governed data access create the right foundations for future AI acceleration.

  • Provide leadership for internal engineering enablement through the Developer Experience function.

  • Define, build, and own Hawk-Eye’s internal Platform-as-a-Service.

You want to make a difference in the world of sports, and HawkEye is your vehicle to do it.

You are a strong technology leader with real experience building data-driven product capabilities in organisations where reliability, scale, and coordination matter.
You join HawkEye with the know-how in creating the ownership, standards, operating discipline, and trust that make good engineering practices useful in practice.

You are credible with senior engineers, comfortable in operationally demanding environments, and able to move between cloud infrastructure, data foundations, organisational design, and delivery reality without losing the plot.
You know how to centralise what must become shared capability without hollowing out the autonomy and judgement of teams that build on top of it.

You care about engineering quality, but you care just as much about business consequence. You know that reliability protects customer trust, governed data creates leverage, and shared standards only matter when they make the organisation materially better at delivering outcomes.

Together, we are unlocking new possibilities and driving global impact as one unified team.
