raw.title: GTM Engineer
raw.description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Go-To-Market at LILT

Go-to-market at LILT is our strategic growth engine. Marketing, Sales Development, Sales, and Revenue Operations run together. We're responsible for telling LILT's story and what makes us different from other translation options in the market. We tell that story to the world with effective demand generation programs, and we turn it into revenue through the outbound and inbound motions our reps run every day. We're shaping how people understand LILT's brand, product, and the category we're building.

We're expert storytellers and operators who work across the entire funnel, from awareness to conversion to expansion. We partner closely with Product and Customer Success to drive pipeline, accelerate adoption, and position LILT as the market leader in enterprise AI translation.

This role has a cross-functional mandate by design. The systems that matter most right now sit on the Sales and RevOps side as much as the Marketing side: Account routing, the lead-to-opportunity process, ADR-facing tooling, signal scanning for the reps. You'll have explicit standing to audit, redesign, and rebuild AI workflows across all of our growth systems.

We're building a world-class team and we're looking for ambitious, curious people who want to grow fast, work with seasoned operators, and help shape the future of AI and language.

Whether it's crafting compelling narratives, launching new capabilities, running high-impact campaigns, or engineering the systems underneath all of it, we move fast, think big, and care deeply about quality. If you're excited about AI, language, and building a category-defining company, you'll thrive here. It's a place to work if you want to have a real impact, learn a ton, working hands-on building content, campaigns, programs, and systems you can be proud of.

GTM Engineering at LILT

As LILT scales, more of our go-to-market motion is powered by agentic AI, systems that can research, enrich, sequence, and act on our behalf, not just report on what already happened. This role sits at the center of that shift. You'll be the builder who turns "we should automate this" into a working, reliable system, owning the tools and automations that keep Marketing, Sales, and RevOps running smoothly.

Examples of the kinds of systems that live in this role:

  • AI-driven meeting and lead qualification agents that compile evidence from across our stack to make a judgment

  • Account signal-scoring systems that combine data into a ranked, defensible view of where the team should spend its time

  • AI-drafted outbound at scale, personalized from live account context

These are illustrative rather than a fixed backlog. The specific builds will change; the shape of the work won't.

Where You'll Work

This role is based in our London office. We work in a hybrid model, with team members in the office 3 days per week to collaborate, brainstorm, and build together. You'll get the energy and creativity of in-person work, combined with the flexibility to focus from home when needed.

What You'll Do

This high-impact, hands-on role is responsible for owning LILT's agentic GTM systems: proposing, designing, building, and maintaining the AI-driven tools and automations that power our go-to-market engine, including our Clay-based enrichment and outbound workflows. You'll also play a critical role in optimizing our go-to-market technology stack, streamlining our lead-to-opportunity process, and helping to maintain day-to-day department operations.

You'll work closely with GTM leadership across Sales Development, Sales, Marketing, and Operations and Systems functions to drive process optimization and overall efficiency. You'll recommend, build, and run cross-functional projects and process improvements that directly impact our operational efficiency and top-line growth of all revenue lines. You'll contribute to the strategy and execution of full-funnel programs that drive predictable, scalable pipeline.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Agentic business systems integration. Propose, design, build, and maintain agentic AI tools and automations that connect and orchestrate our GTM stack end-to-end, reducing manual work and increasing the speed and reliability of our lead-to-revenue motion.

  • Own Clay and the automation stack. Serve as our resident expert on Clay (and similar enrichment/orchestration tools), building and maintaining tables, waterfalls, and workflows that keep our data accurate and our outbound motion running.

  • Salesforce lead-to-opportunity. Partner closely with RevOps to own the workflow from a new lead entering the system, through the various lead stages, and converting to an opportunity, including routing, assignment, and the rules that decide who works what.

  • Full-funnel ownership. Design and optimize the entire lead funnel, from top-of-funnel acquisition through MQL to SQL handoff, driving higher conversion and increased velocity.

  • Lead and contact data integrity. Work with internal tools and external vendors to maintain a high quality database of contacts across our target industries and personas.

  • Partner with Sales. Align tightly with revenue leadership to define pipeline goals, campaign targeting, SLAs, and lead management workflows. Sit close enough to the reps to know which parts of the process actually hurt.

  • Fuel growth. Partner closely with the demand gen team to drive multi-channel campaigns across email marketing, webinars, paid media, SEO, events, outbound motions, and ABM to meet ambitious growth targets.

  • Use data to scale. Build a data-driven culture. Forecast, measure, and communicate program results, continuously optimizing for ROI and CAC efficiency.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Work across demand gen, product marketing, ADRs, and sales ops to build cohesive, conversion-optimized systems and campaigns.

  • Department operations. Help with department-level planning for things like managing campaign budget, team meetings and activities, and annual planning.

  • Documentation and knowledge continuity. Maintain living documentation (Notion) for every agent and workflow you own, to a standard where a new team member or another AI agent could pick up ownership without a live handover call. This is a stated expectation of the role, not an afterthought.

Our Stack

  • CRM and RevOps: Salesforce, Default

  • Enrichment and orchestration: Clay, ZoomInfo

  • Outbound and conversation intelligence: Amplemarket, Trellus

  • Inbound and web conversion: Qualified

  • Marketing automation: HubSpot

  • Analytics: GA4, Salesforce reporting, Looker Studio

  • Build environment: Python, LLM APIs, agentic coding tools, Notion for documentation

Skills and Experience

  • 3-5 years in B2B SaaS or AI/ML go-to-market engineering, RevOps, or marketing operations, with a track record of building automations that actually ship.

  • Hands-on Clay expertise. You've built waterfall enrichment, scoring, and routing in Clay (or a comparable tool), and you can take a new use case from idea to live quickly.

  • Agentic AI and automation fluency. Comfortable proposing, designing, and building agentic workflows and integrations using APIs, webhooks, and orchestration tools, to connect systems and eliminate manual work.

  • Working proficiency in Python/other languages for building and maintaining AI agent pipelines. Comfortable working inside an existing codebase, not just writing standalone scripts.

  • Comfortable reasoning about tradeoffs under cost and token constraints. You can explain not just what you built, but why you didn't build the more expensive or more complex version.

  • Strong Salesforce fundamentals. You can build reports, understand the object model and the automation layer, and use what you find to change how the funnel actually performs.

  • A point of view on where AI in GTM is heading. We'll ask. We're less interested in whether we agree than in whether you've thought about it seriously.

  • Obsessed with the metrics that matter: MQLs, pipeline, bookings, funnel conversion, velocity, CAC, and ROI.

  • Familiarity with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot or similar) a plus.

  • Ability to build relationships and work cross-functionally.

  • Smart, curious, and hard-working.

  • Natural collaborator and communicator, comfortable presenting to executives, boards, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

  • Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times.

raw.title: Atlassian Senior Consultant - ITSM/ESM Practice
raw.description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity. By combining deep process expertise with modern collaboration, automation, and value stream practices, Valiantys enables business, IT, and product teams to design connected, efficient, and human-centered ways of working. With a strong focus on the modern workforce, the company helps customers reimagine service delivery beyond IT, streamline cross-functional workflows, and improve flow and throughput for engineering teams. For more information, visit https://valiantys.com.


Job Summary

As a Senior Solution Consultant – ITSM, you will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, helping them translate business and service management challenges into practical, scalable solutions built on Atlassian tools and industry best practices.

You will lead discovery and solution design, guide customers through ITSM transformation, and own the solution intent throughout delivery. Working closely with Technical Consultants, Technical Architects, Project Managers, Engagement Managers, and Sales, you will ensure solutions remain feasible, aligned with customer needs, and focused on measurable outcomes.

 

What You’ll Be Working On

Discover & Advise

  • Lead discovery and scoping workshops to understand customer objectives, pain points, processes, constraints, maturity, and desired outcomes
  • Analyze and challenge existing service management processes and recommend practical improvements based on ITSM and Atlassian leading practices
  • Translate customer requirements into solution themes, priorities, success measures, and implementation considerations
  • Advise customers across ITSM practices such as incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset and configuration management, service portals, and service operations
  • Facilitate conversations with business and technical stakeholders and identify where additional specialist expertise is required

    • Design & Shape Solutions

    • Translate business needs into high-level solution designs, roadmaps, configuration blueprints, and implementation-ready recommendations
    • Design scalable ITSM solutions leveraging Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian ecosystem
    • Produce clear deliverables including discovery outputs, current-state and future-state process maps, Solution Design Documents, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision logs, and requirements traceability
    • Document assumptions, dependencies, design decisions, trade-offs, and unresolved questions to maintain a shared understanding of the solution
    • Collaborate with Technical Consultants and Technical Architects to validate feasibility, scalability, integrations, automation, reporting, and platform constraints

      • Own & Guide Delivery

      • Own the solution intent throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring requirements, design decisions, acceptance criteria, and business outcomes remain visible during delivery
      • Support delivery teams by clarifying business context, requirements, design rationale, and customer priorities when questions or trade-offs arise
      • Facilitate solution checkpoints, design reviews, and working sessions with business and technical stakeholders
      • Partner with Project Managers and Technical Leads to maintain alignment between the approved solution design and delivered outcomes
      • Help ensure solutions remain appropriate for the customer’s maturity, constraints, and stated success measures

        • Support Pre-Sales & Client Growth

        • Support pre-sales activities with discovery insights, solution recommendations, effort assumptions, delivery considerations, and scope clarification
        • Contribute to proposals and Statements of Work where solution design, assumptions, acceptance criteria, dependencies, or delivery risks need to be clarified
        • Identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and scope boundaries before opportunities transition into delivery
        • Build and maintain trusted customer relationships throughout the engagement lifecycle
        • Identify opportunities for optimization, expansion, or follow-on advisory work and collaborate with the appropriate Sales or Engagement owner

          • Contribute & Grow

          • Mentor Consultants on discovery, advisory practices, solution documentation, and customer-facing communication
          • Contribute to internal playbooks, discovery frameworks, reusable ITSM solution assets, process maps, and delivery templates
          • Share knowledge and leading practices across the Solution Consulting and wider Delivery teams
          • Use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, documentation, synthesis, quality review, and knowledge reuse while ensuring outputs remain accurate and customer-specific
          • Stay current with developments across the Atlassian ecosystem and trends in ITSM, ESM, Agile, Work Management, automation, reporting, and enterprise collaboration
          • Maintain and develop your expertise through continuous learning and relevant certifications
 

Do You Have What It Takes?

To succeed in this role, you bring:

  • Significant experience in ITSM consulting, solution consulting, or service management transformation
  • Strong knowledge of Jira Service Management and the Atlassian ecosystem
  • Demonstrated experience leading customer discovery, requirements, and solution design workshops
  • Strong understanding of ITSM practices, including incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset and configuration management
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into practical solution designs and implementation recommendations
  • Experience producing high-quality customer-facing solution documentation, process maps, requirements, and acceptance criteria
  • Ability to balance customer expectations, business outcomes, platform capabilities, technical constraints, and delivery realities
  • Experience collaborating with technical consultants, architects, project managers, and commercial teams
  • Experience mentoring or supporting the development of less experienced consultants
  • Atlassian and/or ITIL certifications are a plus

    • Your strengths

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
    • Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management abilities
    • Ability to engage confidently with both business and technical stakeholders
    • Consultative mindset with the ability to challenge constructively and influence decisions
    • Ability to simplify complex requirements and turn them into clear, actionable solutions
    • Strong sense of ownership while working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams
    • Proactive and pragmatic approach to solving customer challenges
    • Attention to detail and commitment to high-quality deliverables
    • Customer-focused approach with a strong orientation toward measurable outcomes
    • Ability to mentor and support the growth of other consultants

      • Why Join Valiantys?

      At Valiantys, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make an impact.

      Meaning : Drive strategic transformation projects and influence outcomes
      Learning : Continuous development through training, certifications, and communities
      Flexibility : Hybrid work model supporting work-life balance

      Additional benefits:

      • International and multicultural environment
      • Flexible remote work policy
      • Meal vouchers
      • 100% covered health insurance (for you and your family)
      • Choice of equipment (PC or Mac)
      • Supportive and collaborative culture

        • Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to personal background, identity, or beliefs.

title: Director, Customer Support Network Strategy, Service Design & Workforce Management
description: <p>Wolt and Roo operate under the DoorDash umbrella, and Customer Support sits at the intersection of brand experience, unit economics and long-term growth. This role owns the strategy on:</p> <ol> <li>Where should we operate support, at what scale, and at what cost, across a rolling multi-year horizon?</li> <li>How do we architect frontline service design to be AI-ready as frontline tooling evolves, deliver best-in-class customer experience, and remain cost-efficient?</li> <li>How do we manage our workforce with precision, eliminating waste, consolidating overlapping structures, and continuously improving headcount efficiency through automation and org redesign?</li> </ol> <p>This is a permanent leadership role. The person in this seat will own network strategy, service design and workforce management as a continuous discipline, embedding deeply into Wolt, Roo and DoorDash technology stacks, building and refreshing the financial and operational case for change, and evolving the execution roadmap as the business, technology and market shift.</p> <h2><strong>Scope of Responsibility</strong></h2> <h3><strong>A. Support Service Design</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the demand and supply planning, and scheduling for the network, partnering deeply with upstream business owners and defect elimination to enable forecasting accuracy.&nbsp;</li> <li>Own ongoing assessment of how service is structured and delivered at the frontline across both brands.</li> <li>Maintain the role architecture map: what roles exist, what they do, where they overlap.</li> <li>Evaluate how tools (CRM, WFM, knowledge base, AI tools, ticketing) enable or constrain frontline roles, and keep this view current as tooling changes.</li> <li>Own and evolve the target-state frontline model aligned to AI-augmented ways of working.</li> <li>Continuously run gap analysis: current state vs. target state, with prioritised interventions.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>B. Support Site Strategy</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the support site footprint across both brands as an ongoing portfolio.</li> <li>Maintain and refresh strategic site scenarios across cost, quality, risk and scalability as conditions change.</li> <li>Own the financial model underpinning site strategy: OpEx, CapEx, transition cost, and planning cycles.</li> <li>Continuously assess BPO vs. in-house mix, nearshore vs. offshore trade-offs, and consolidation opportunities.</li> <li>Bring forward exec-ready recommendations as circumstances warrant, with clear pros, cons and decision criteria.</li> <li>Keep the site strategy framed against contact volume reduction through automation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>C. Workforce Management Transformation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own WFM maturity across both brands on an ongoing basis: demand forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management.</li> <li>Identify and close tooling gaps and duplication across Wolt and Roo WFM stacks.</li> <li>Own and evolve the consolidated WFM target operating model.</li> <li>Own the continuous efficiency case, driven through:</li> <ul> <li>Org consolidation:&nbsp; merging duplicated WFM roles across the two brands.</li> <li>Contact automation: defect elimination and end-to-end customer-facing automation.</li> <li>AI-assisted agent workflows: human-in-the-loop bot interfaces, AI-guided resolution, next-best-action tools.</li> <li>Scheduling and real-time optimisation via AI/ML tooling.</li> </ul> <li>Own tooling requirements and vendor strategy (shortlists, entries, exits) as an ongoing responsibility.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>D. DoorDash Technology Integration</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Maintain deep, current working knowledge of DoorDash's support technology stack.</li> <li>Continuously translate technology capabilities into concrete business levers for the Wolt and Roo context.</li> <li>Own the dependency map between integration milestones and the Support transformation roadmap.</li> <li>Flag risks early where integration timelines could affect strategy execution.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>E. Execution Planning</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the rolling execution plan: prioritised initiatives, owners, investment, expected outcomes, refreshed as priorities shift.</li> <li>Own the forward-looking roadmap: strategic bets, sequencing logic, capability-build requirements.</li> <li>Own stakeholder alignment across Support Operations, Product, Finance and People functions on an ongoing basis.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Core Ongoing Responsibilities &amp;</strong> Outcomes</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Current state visibility:</strong> Maintain a living view of service design, site footprint, financial planning cycles and WFM maturity across Wolt &amp; Roo, with an opinionated, forward-looking perspective on where the network needs to go.</li> <li><strong>DoorDash technology translation:</strong> Continuously map DoorDash technology capabilities to Wolt/Roo business levers, tracking upstream product, tooling and integration roadmaps and their implications for network design.</li> <li><strong>Support site strategy:</strong> Maintain a multi-year scenario model with full financial analysis, pros &amp; cons, and a standing recommended path, developed in partnership with the wider Strategy and Operations organisation.</li> <li><strong>Planning mechanisms:</strong> Own and run weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual mechanisms for demand and supply planning (long and short term) and scheduling/real-time management, optimising for customer experience and efficiency, with clear visibility for executive leadership.</li> <li><strong>WFM transformation:</strong> Own the consolidated operating model, tooling spec, and the efficiency case for the organisation, with signed-off financial projections refreshed as the business evolves.</li> <li><strong>Roadmap ownership:</strong> Maintain a rolling forward roadmap covering strategic sequencing, capability investments, and automation maturity milestones, ratified through regular leadership review.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder alignment:</strong> Keep all key workstream owners briefed, committed and clear on accountabilities on an ongoing basis.</li> </ul> <p>All recommendations must be underpinned by a financial model, and must be decision-ready on first presentation.</p> <h2><strong>Operating Rhythm</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Embed &amp; Orient (ongoing as scope evolves):</strong> Maintain stakeholder maps; stay immersed in Wolt, Roo &amp; DoorDash systems; keep baseline data current; revisit scope and success criteria as the business changes.</li> <li><strong>Diagnose:</strong> Continuously reassess current state across all workstreams; keep DoorDash tech translation current; surface risks and quick wins as they emerge.</li> <li><strong>Design &amp; Model:</strong> Maintain and evolve site strategy scenarios, the frontline service design blueprint, the WFM target model, and supporting financial models.</li> <li><strong>Synthesise &amp; Align:</strong> Run regular executive forums and stakeholder sign-off cycles.</li> <li><strong>Roadmap &amp; Continuity:</strong> Maintain the forward roadmap; ensure knowledge is embedded across the team rather than concentrated in one person.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Required Competencies</strong></h2> <table> <tbody> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Competency</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>What Good Looks Like</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Strategic clarity</p> </td> <td> <p>Translates complexity into a small number of decisive choices. Never produces a report that fails to recommend.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Financial rigour</p> </td> <td> <p>Builds robust P&amp;L and scenario models independently. Understands how operational levers flow to unit economics.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>CX &amp; support operations depth</p> </td> <td> <p>Credible across service design, contact centre strategy, WFM and automation.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>AI &amp; tooling fluency</p> </td> <td> <p>Understands AI automation in a CX context: IVR/chatbot design, agent assist tools, LLM-powered workflows.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Speed to competence</p> </td> <td> <p>Gets up to speed fast on unfamiliar technology stacks. Can read a product and understand business implications without hand-holding.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Stakeholder influence</p> </td> <td> <p>Earns trust quickly at VP level and above. Drives alignment without authority. Comfortable challenging conventional thinking.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Structured communication</p> </td> <td> <p>Writes concisely and presents with clarity.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Operator's mindset</p> </td> <td> <p>Thinks in outcomes and owns them over time.</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <h2><strong>Experience Profile</strong></h2> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years in customer support strategy, CX operations or contact centre consulting/leadership.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience designing and executing site strategy at scale (multi-site, multi-brand, international).</li> <li>Deep workforce management expertise: forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management.</li> <li>Experience leading or sponsoring automation programmes, contact reduction, chatbot, AI agent-assist.</li> <li>Track record of delivering headcount efficiencies without degrading quality.</li> <li>Strong financial modelling capability, built business cases independently.</li> <li>Experience working inside or alongside a fast-growth tech company or marketplace.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Highly Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct experience in food delivery, logistics or three-sided marketplace support.</li> <li>Prior exposure to DoorDash, Wolt or comparable platforms.</li> <li>Background delivering inside complex integrations or M&amp;A contexts.</li> <li>Familiarity with WFM platforms (e.g. Verint, AWS Connect, Assembled, Calibrio) and CX tooling (e.g. Zendesk, Intercom).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Ways of Working</strong></h2> <ul> <li>This is a hands-on leadership role.&nbsp;</li> <li>The role requires deep, ongoing immersion in internal data, systems and teams.</li> <li>All recommendations must arrive decision-ready.</li> <li>The role operates with a high degree of autonomy, with regular visibility to leadership through written updates and reviews.</li> <li>Escalation discipline: flag blockers fast. Never sit on a problem for more than 48 hours.</li> <li>Intellectual honesty is non-negotiable.</li> </ul> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

(Email, Excel, Word and SharePoint).</li> <li>Experience of product specification systems (especially Oracle Brand Compliance) would be desirable but not essential.</li> <li>If you have experience managing, supporting and guiding a small team this would be an advantage.</li> </ul> <p data-start="2737" data-end="2757"><strong>What's in it for me?</strong></p> <p data-start="2759" data-end="2777"><strong>Career Development</strong></p> <ul data-start="2779" data-end="3016"> <li data-section-id="1i6mc1e" data-start="2779" data-end="2882">Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&amp;D team.</li> <li data-section-id="o4jcdc" data-start="2883" data-end="3016">Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.</li> </ul> <p data-start="3018" data-end="3032"><strong>Enhanced Leave</strong></p> <ul data-start="3034" data-end="3351"> <li data-section-id="k3lh31" data-start="3034" data-end="3076">25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.</li> <li data-section-id="1621qdr" data-start="3077" data-end="3158">Don't want to work on your birthday? title: Associate Director, Platform Engineering
description: About Relation Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure. We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact. We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age. By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients. The opportunity As Associate Director, Platform Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for the hybrid compute infrastructure, developer platform and scientific compute environments that power Relation’s machine learning and drug discovery work. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will work closely with your team and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy. Our platform spans on-premises infrastructure and public cloud environments, supporting computational scientist notebooks through Kubeflow, model training and serving, internal services and genomic pipelines. You will set the technical direction across these areas, build and develop the team responsible for delivering them, and ensure our platform continues to evolve alongside the needs of our science. Day to day, you will Partner with the VP of Engineering and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy. Own the architectural strategy for our Kubernetes-based clusters and broader hybrid infrastructure, setting the technical standards and guardrails within which the team designs, builds and operates. Lead and develop the Platform Engineering team, hiring and retaining exceptional engineers, setting clear expectations and creating the conditions for them to do their best work. Own the scientific compute platform, ensuring it reliably and efficiently meets the evolving needs of our Machine Learning and Data Science teams. Drive the maturity of our CI/CD pipelines, internal services and developer tooling, treating the platform as a product and our internal engineers and computational scientists as its customers. Establish comprehensive observability and robust disaster recovery and failover strategies across on-premises and cloud environments. Own Relation’s platform security controls, including IAM, secrets management, network policy and vulnerability management, ensuring the platform meets the data governance standards required of a clinical-stage biotech working with sensitive patient-derived data. Professionally, you will have Significant experience in platform, infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with a strong track record of building and operating complex production environments. Experience leading engineers, either formally or informally, with responsibility for significant workstreams from strategy through to delivery. You have set technical direction others have followed, mentored and developed engineers, and taken accountability for live production systems. Strong hands-on operational experience. You have participated in on-call rotations for production infrastructure, led responses to significant incidents and driven the subsequent changes required to prevent recurrence. Deep expertise in Kubernetes, alongside experience operating infrastructure across hybrid on-premises and cloud environments. Experience building, running or evolving MLOps infrastructure, ideally including notebook environments such as Kubeflow, GPU compute for distributed training and model serving. Familiarity with batch compute for data-intensive scientific workloads, with an understanding of the reliability, scalability and reproducibility requirements of scientific data pipelines. A track record of maturing CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling and observability across complex, multi-environment platforms. Strong security fundamentals, with hands-on experience designing and implementing appropriate security controls. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to co-own strategy with senior stakeholders, challenge decisions constructively and communicate platform strategy clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Bonus Experience : Exposure to relevant compliance and governance frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR within a research or scientific environment. Personally, you Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams. Take ownership of your work , proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work. Technically deep enough to earn the respect of a highly skilled engineering team, while being equally comfortable influencing and contributing at leadership level Communicate openly and directly , give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect. Actively seek out diverse perspectives , build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams. Embrace challenges with openness and resilience , set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes. Working Style & Culture at Relation At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment , where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! raw.title: Associate Director, Platform Engineering
raw.description:
About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

 

The opportunity

As Associate Director, Platform Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for the hybrid compute infrastructure, developer platform and scientific compute environments that power Relation’s machine learning and drug discovery work. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will work closely with your team and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy.

Our platform spans on-premises infrastructure and public cloud environments, supporting computational scientist notebooks through Kubeflow, model training and serving, internal services and genomic pipelines. You will set the technical direction across these areas, build and develop the team responsible for delivering them, and ensure our platform continues to evolve alongside the needs of our science.

Day to day, you will

  • Partner with the VP of Engineering and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy.

  • Own the architectural strategy for our Kubernetes-based clusters and broader hybrid infrastructure, setting the technical standards and guardrails within which the team designs, builds and operates.

  • Lead and develop the Platform Engineering team, hiring and retaining exceptional engineers, setting clear expectations and creating the conditions for them to do their best work.

  • Own the scientific compute platform, ensuring it reliably and efficiently meets the evolving needs of our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

  • Drive the maturity of our CI/CD pipelines, internal services and developer tooling, treating the platform as a product and our internal engineers and computational scientists as its customers.

  • Establish comprehensive observability and robust disaster recovery and failover strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Own Relation’s platform security controls, including IAM, secrets management, network policy and vulnerability management, ensuring the platform meets the data governance standards required of a clinical-stage biotech working with sensitive patient-derived data.

 

Professionally, you will have

  • Significant experience in platform, infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with a strong track record of building and operating complex production environments.

  • Experience leading engineers, either formally or informally, with responsibility for significant workstreams from strategy through to delivery. You have set technical direction others have followed, mentored and developed engineers, and taken accountability for live production systems.

  • Strong hands-on operational experience. You have participated in on-call rotations for production infrastructure, led responses to significant incidents and driven the subsequent changes required to prevent recurrence.

  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes, alongside experience operating infrastructure across hybrid on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Experience building, running or evolving MLOps infrastructure, ideally including notebook environments such as Kubeflow, GPU compute for distributed training and model serving.

  • Familiarity with batch compute for data-intensive scientific workloads, with an understanding of the reliability, scalability and reproducibility requirements of scientific data pipelines.

  • A track record of maturing CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling and observability across complex, multi-environment platforms.

  • Strong security fundamentals, with hands-on experience designing and implementing appropriate security controls.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to co-own strategy with senior stakeholders, challenge decisions constructively and communicate platform strategy clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Bonus Experience:

  • Exposure to relevant compliance and governance frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR within a research or scientific environment.

 

Personally, you

  • Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams.

  • Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

  • Technically deep enough to earn the respect of a highly skilled engineering team, while being equally comfortable influencing and contributing at leadership level

  • Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

  • Actively seek out diverse perspectives, build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams.

  • Embrace challenges with openness and resilience, set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes.

 

Working Style & Culture at Relation

At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment, where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! The patient is waiting!

 

Recruitment Agencies

Please note that Relation does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Resumes should not be forwarded to our job aliases or employees. Relation will not be liable for any fees associated with unsolicited CVs.

title: Senior Performance Lead - Trade Acquisition
description: As our next Senior Performance Marketing Lead, Trade Acquisition , you'll take single-point accountability for how we grow trade supply through paid channels. This isn't about hitting numbers someone else set. It's about setting the goals, building the roadmap and owning the strategy that the whole trade acquisition function is measured against. You'll shape how we invest, what we prioritise, and how the acquisition engine evolves over the next 12 to 24 months, working alongside senior stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product and Finance. Forget long lists, here’s what you’ll actually spend your time on: Set the paid acquisition strategy: build the annual and quarterly plan that translates our business goals into clear channel priorities, investment and targets, rather than delivering against a plan set elsewhere. Own PPC, paid social, affiliates and remarketing end-to-end, covering strategy, budget, vendor relationships, testing and performance across each channel. Set and own the commercial targets that matter (MQLs, CAC and LTV:CAC), partnering closely with Finance on forecasting, unit models and the business case for new investment. Build a structured test-and-learn roadmap, sequencing initiatives across quarters and spotting risks such as rising CAC or channel saturation before they bite, while exploring new channels and partnerships as we grow. Partner with Sales, Product & CRO, CRM and Data teams to align lead quality, sharpen the acquisition journey and improve attribution and measurement. Report performance to senior stakeholders with a clear narrative on the mid to long-term health of the acquisition engine, not just in-period results, and represent trade acquisition in planning forums. It’s not about ticking every box. It’s about turning up curious, ready to crack on. You’ll do well here if you bring: Experience (or eagerness to grow into) owning paid acquisition strategy across channels like PPC, paid social, affiliates or remarketing. Confidence setting your own targets and owning the trade-offs between growth, efficiency and quality, rather than just delivering against numbers you're handed. Commercial fluency: comfortable building forecasts and business cases, and working closely with Finance on unit economics. A collaborative streak: you're just as happy partnering with Sales, Product, CRM and Data teams as you are deep in a channel dashboard. We believe great work deserves great rewards. Here’s just a taste: Competitive salary + annual bonus Employee Share Programme Health, well-being and learning support Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme and Cycle Scheme Birthday/Special day leave Buy & sell holiday scheme 1 week’s paid charity leave and much more! How we’ll get to know each other: Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners 1st stage interview with Senior Performance Marketing Lead 2nd Stage interview with VP Sales + Sales Manager Final stage interview includes a case study presentation with hiring manager If this sounds like the place where you can do your best work, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box Want to join our Talent Community and be one of the first to know about our vacancies? Register your interest on our Registration Form At the moment, this role isn’t open to visa sponsorship applications. About us We’re Checkatrade – the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business. We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>Build something world-changing</strong> - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.</li> <li><strong>Make real impact</strong> - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.</li> <li><strong>Accelerate your growth</strong> - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.</li> <li><strong>Join a motivated team</strong> - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.</li> </ul> <h3>What’s ahead in the UK</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Opportunity to convert to an FTE role</strong> <ul> <li><strong>Become an owner</strong> – Your own stake in the business with our employee options program<br><strong>Invest in your growth</strong> – Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave<br><strong>Work flexibly</strong> – Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration<br><strong>Support your well-being</strong> – Private health insurance through Vitality or opt for a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you<br><strong>Take time off</strong> – 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Join a connected team</strong> – A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport, and seasonal events</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Senior CRM Manager - Lifecycle & Retention
raw.description:
Join our expanding Product Growth team! We're actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. You'll build and scale the lifecycle systems that drive retention, upsell, and customer lifetime value for millions of everyday earners across Africa.

The Impact 💚

You'll design the retention and upsell infrastructure that turns first-time customers into long-term, high-value ones, driving measurable CLV growth while creating financial inclusion for Africa's traditionally excluded. We've already helped over 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🏗️ Build lifecycle CRM from the ground up: design and scale retention, repayment, and upsell programmes across 4 African markets (Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana), working with proprietary data from millions of customers and a unique distribution model (30,000+ field agents + 300 telesales)

💰 Own retention and upsell outcomes: your success is measured in CLV growth, retention and renewal rates, repayment behaviour, and upsell revenue

🎲 Bring fresh thinking: we want someone who pushes lifecycle beyond the standard playbook, gamification, loyalty mechanics, streaks, rewards, and other creative growth levers that make repayment and engagement genuinely enjoyable, not just another push notification

🎯 Nice to have, not required: we're curious whether you've also touched performance or paid marketing. We don't run that as part of Growth today, but understanding how it connects to retention is something we're actively thinking about, and your perspective could help shape where we take it

🚀 Go hands-on daily: build automated journeys, design experiments, analyse results, and scale what works

🏆 Global recognition: join a company named by TIME 100 as one of the world's most influential and by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing for 5 consecutive years (2022-2026)

What You'll Do

You'll own lifecycle CRM strategy and execution end to end. Build automated customer journeys in CleverTap, run experiments on messaging and timing, analyse retention and repayment cohorts, and scale successful programmes across markets. Partner with Product, Commercial, and Operations teams to turn customer behaviour into retention and growth opportunities.

Your Core Responsibilities

  • Build and scale multi-channel lifecycle programmes: design onboarding, retention, churn prevention, and upsell journeys across SMS, WhatsApp, push, and in-app messaging

  • Design behavioural trigger-based upsell systems: move customers from entry products (smartphones/e-bikes) to higher-value bundles (digital loans, insurance, device protection) based on payment behaviour and engagement signals

  • Run rigorous experiments: A/B test messaging, timing, incentives, and offers with clear hypotheses and statistical rigour, then turn wins into repeatable playbooks

  • Own retention economics: track and optimise LTV, cohort retention, renewal rates, and upsell performance, translating insights into action

  • Scale what works across markets: turn successful experiments into documented frameworks that enable teams to execute retention initiatives across 4 African markets

Your Environment 💼

Tech Stack: CleverTap, Braze, MoEngage, or similar

Analytics: Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker

Channels: WhatsApp, SMS, push, in-app messaging, telesales

What You Need

  • 6+ years building and scaling CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally in businesses where daily or weekly customer engagement drives retention and revenue.

  • You've built CRM systems, not just optimised them, whether migrating platforms (Mailchimp → Braze), designing journey architecture from scratch, or scaling programmes across markets.

  • You're hands-on in CRM platforms daily, personally building journeys in tools like Braze, CleverTap, MoEngage, Customer.io, or Iterable.

  • You think in business outcomes, your achievements mention LTV growth, retention revenue, upsell rates, renewal improvements, not just open rates or engagement metrics.

  • You run rigorous experiments, designing tests with clear hypotheses, control groups, and measurable success criteria.

  • You bring fresh eyes to lifecycle marketing, someone who's introduced gamification, loyalty programmes, streaks, badges, or other non-obvious engagement mechanics into a retention strategy, and can talk about what worked, what didn't, and why.

  • Relevant backgrounds we're interested in: MVNO experience, super-apps with daily engagement models, mobile gaming with daily retention mechanics, prepaid subscription services, or B2C fintech/subscription businesses where high-frequency engagement drives the model.

  • Bonus, not required: exposure to performance or paid marketing (paid social, paid search, app install campaigns), and a point of view on how acquisition spend and targeting could connect to retention outcomes. This isn't something you'd own, we're just genuinely interested in how you think about it.
